query: Which operational metrics (CAI, review depth, time-to-first-response, commit tenure) most reliably proxy configuration expertise and predict defect introduction across diverse projects?

response.query: Which operational metrics (CAI, review depth, time-to-first-response, commit tenure) most reliably proxy configuration expertise and predict defect introduction across diverse projects?
response.answer: Time-to-first-response and commit tenure most reliably proxy configuration expertise and predict defect introduction. Review depth also correlates with defect prediction.
